text: i tried the painting again, and the lock up between selecting one to the other is all gone, but it is not updating the paint to it either, [Image #94] [Image #95]
resolution: The picked material not showing on painted tiles (then showing on only a sliver) was the pooled ground D buffer in framework/gpu/3d.zig: the layout-v3 stream grew to ~29-32k floats per chunk (packed cells + the new 14400-float per-cell material tail) but r3d_ground_data buffers and bind groups were sized at GROUND_DATA_FLOATS=20000, so the upload clamped at the cap and the material tail was cut — cells past the cut read binding 0 = kind default, which is exactly the perfect-line split in the screenshot. Raised the cap to 34000 (documented worst-case breakdown: 6 header + 2304 palette + 1024 bindings + 14400 cells + 14400 materials = 32134) and made overflow a LOUD one-shot error so the next layout growth can never silently truncate again. Needs a Zig rebuild.
